name: CoinGecko API
summary: Cryptocurrency market data (prices, market caps, volumes, OHLCV, onchain DEX pools and tokens) over a REST API, hosted MCP servers, an SDK and an agent SKILL package. Three ways in for an agent, all documented by the vendor: a keyless public tier with no sign-up at a low IP-shared rate limit, keyed plans (a free Demo key and paid tiers) and an experimental x402 pay-per-use path with no key or account at all, $0.005 USDC per request when measured on 2026-10-27 against the $0.01 the vendor's page still documents.

payments.notes: Measured unpaid 2026-09-11, 09-19, 09-28 and 2026-10-27: 402, x402Version 2, scheme exact. On 10-27, 5000 units of USDC ($0.005) on Base, Solana or Polygon; in September, 10000 ($0.01) on Base or Solana. The docs still say $0.01 and two networks. Keyed plans are card or crypto subscriptions.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-09-10, 09-18, 09-19, 09-28 and 2026-10-27, no credentials: keyless REST simple/price 200; MCP initialize 200 (server 8.1.0 on 09-28, 8.0.0 on 09-18), tools/list 200 with the same two tools; no discovery document at either well-known URI; unpaid x402 GET 402 ($0.005, three networks).

jobs.summary: Vendor's llms.txt: real-time and historical cryptocurrency data (prices, OHLCV, market cap, volume, NFT and onchain DeFi data) for coins, tokens, pools and exchanges via REST API, WebSocket and Webhooks, with an SDK and hosted MCP servers. Vendor's claim; freshness and coverage not measured.
